cohort: 1212 children (second generation) from the original 1993 Pelotas Birth Cohort, whose parents had their last follow-up at 22 years old
finding: The baseline assessment of the 93Cohort-II demonstrated the feasibility of conducting intergenerational cohort studies in middle-income countries and provided valuable data on the health and well-being of the second generation.
mod_finding: Half of the children were born by cesarean section.
